description: exp365 architecture (tiny LUT-LM, ~43M, joint qkv+additive v, per-layer residual_lut) with ALL LUT modules replaced by SoftMultiHeadLUT(hamming_1_mask=True). Tests the masked-soft approach with SELF-CONSISTENT backward (autograd through actual forward) at scale where it fits. Direct comparison: exp365 (1.6215, soft K-row baseline), exp386 (1.6164, MHLut smooth n_alt=3). Mathematically equivalent to (NAP+1)-way softmax over Hamming-1 ball — but uses single matmul + finite mask (-1e4 outside ball) instead of explicit gather. Backward via autograd → restricted to (NAP+1) ball rows for input grad too (no soft K-row surrogate).
